thread:
maya: deploy-bot auto-paused the cut. CI shows repeated cache lease evictions during artifact fetch -> thundering retry causing 429s. blocking the 15:00 change window.
ton y: noted. job 314 logs: `cache-lease: lost lease while streaming`, then a bunch of simultaneous retry attempts from workers. link: https://ci.internal/redwood/builds/314
ian: looks like the cache service returned transient 503 then our retry backoff didn't jitter enough. hammered the proxy.
infra-sre: confirmed. cache service hit a short GC spike and rejected lease renewals at 14:46 UTC, clients retried in lockstep. we're throttling now and increasing jitter.
maya: options: 1) pin to last-green artifact and manual promote to keep the window, 2) wait for jitter to take effect and rerun (risk missing window), 3) force-promote (bad for audit). Thoughts?
ton y: prefer pin to avoid cascading client retries and risk of partial rollout. we should also mark the release so we can unpin after a clean rerun.
ian: agree with pin. also add a temporary client-side fix: increase retry jitter and reduce immediate concurrency for fetch. I'll open CHG-512 to follow up.
release-manager: product needs clarity. if we pin, add a release note explaining temporary pin and scheduled rerun outside the window for validation.
maya: happy to pin and do manual promote. I'll not use force. deploy-bot, grant manual promote for maya?
deploy-bot: deploy paused by pipeline failure. Manual promotion allowed for user: maya. Audit id: db-20260325-618999.
infra-sre: cache service reporting recovery at 14:55 UTC and we've applied client-side rate limit advisory. recommend waiting 5m then running a validation pipeline in a non-critical window.
ton y: go ahead with pin. candidate: `artifacts/staging@sha256:77b4ef`. Tag with `temp-pin-cache-lease-eviction`.
maya: pin applied and manual promote started via UI. release note: "Temporary pin due to cache lease evictions causing thundering retries; rerun scheduled in 30m." doc: https://docs.internal/release/2026-03-25-cache-pin
deploy-bot: manual promote completed by maya at 14:58 UTC. Canary rollout started. Audit id: db-20260325-618999-01.
ian: queued validation rerun for 15:30 UTC. if rerun passes, we will unpin and promote original artifact. if it fails, we will keep pin and trigger rollback playbook.
release-manager: please add MIG-512 and ART-1023 to track infra change + release follow-up. notifying stakeholders in product/docs.
ton y: monitoring logs and error rates. so far canary health looks stable.
maya: summary: pinned to last-green to protect change window; manual promote done; infra applied jitter and throttle; rerun scheduled. closing thread unless regressions show up. :white_check_mark:
